map.每个 ASCII 字符占 8 位（1 字节），可用二进制 8 位或十六进制 2: Each ASCII character is 8 bits (1 byte), representable as 8 binary bits or 2 hex digits. Paste a continuous encoded string, choose the radix, and decode it into readable text.
map.按 8 位一字节解析：ASCII 编码范围 0 至 127，如 01000001: Parse 8 bits per byte: ASCII ranges 0 to 127, e.g. 01000001 = 65 = letter A, 00110000 = 48 = digit 0; each hex digit maps to 4 bits (0x41 = 01000001); printable chars are 32 to 126, others are control chars (0x0A newline, 0x0D carriage return); group by 8 bits when unseparated, or split by the delimiter when space-separated, then convert each group to decimal and map to a character.
map.二进制每组 8 位对应一个字节；十六进制每 2 位对应一个字节，空格、换行会被自: Each binary group of 8 bits is one byte; each hex pair is one byte; spaces and newlines are ignored automatically.
map.仅覆盖 ASCII（0–127）。非 ASCII（如中文 UTF-8）是多字节编: Covers ASCII only (0-127). Non-ASCII (e.g. Chinese UTF-8) is multi-byte; it needs UTF-8 byte splitting then per-byte conversion, which this tool does not support directly.
map.若结果出现乱码，多半是位数不对或混入了其他字符，请先清理输入。: If the result is garbled, the bit count is likely wrong or other characters were mixed in; clean the input first.
